## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

---

## Type of Change

<!-- Mark the applicable option with (x) -->

- ( ) `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- ( ) `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- ( ) `improvement`: Improvement to an existing feature
- ( ) `perf`: Performance improvement
- ( ) `refactor`: Code refactoring without changing behavior
- ( ) `docs`: Documentation updates
- ( ) `style`: Formatting, missing semicolons, etc. (no code logic changes)
- ( ) `test`: Adding or correcting tests
- ( ) `build`: Changes affecting the build system or external dependencies
- ( ) `ci`: CI configuration files and scripts
- ( ) `chore`: Maintenance tasks or repository housekeeping

---

## PR Checklist

- [ ] My PR title follows the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification: `<type>(<optional scope>): <description>` (e.g., `feat(ui): add grid customization options`).
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`flutter analyze`).
- [ ] I have tested my changes on an Android TV device or emulator.
- [ ] Existing and/or new tests pass locally (`flutter test`).
